scope: SOURCE ONLY: frozen implementation source, authored source contract, and synthetic injected tests

independent_test.directory_enumeration: Only importlib source-directory resolution; no proc, lifecycle, lock or runtime namespace enumeration
independent_test.allowed_file_reads: Read-only Python source/bytecode under the experiment source root or standard Python library roots

retained_reviewer_harness_failure.cause: Reviewer early audit allowed only root source directories, so it rejected importlib enumeration of the original qwen35_package_serial_runtime_v7 source package before tests loaded. The system exception reporter subsequently attempted /etc/default/apport; that read was also blocked.
retained_reviewer_harness_failure.correction: Permit directory enumeration only when initiated by frozen importlib source resolution under the known source/library roots; restore sys.__excepthook__ to avoid the system exception reporter. Keep all runtime/data/process/lock/raw operations forbidden.

resolved_review_finding.issue: The earlier draft ran extension metadata reads and the complete original serial_catalog consumer outside the read-only cadence and passed a forced global guard per row, restoring repeated full History/source/holder scans.
resolved_review_finding.resolution: Frozen v2 places the extension read, unchanged completed_outputs and complete rebind/original serial_catalog under composition_consumer with the same history_guard and forced entry/exit checks. Each actual publication executes after leaving that stage and has a forced full guard.
resolved_review_finding.verification: Source path review plus the real source-extracted original consumer fixture, callback counts, fixed-time zero repeated global-check assertions, mutation rejection and mandatory fences before receipt/catalog/idle writes.

preserved_properties: Original failed remover and failed finalizer must be distinct real nonzero tool terminals; exact failed-finalizer argv, original source, original terminal, running and lock bindings remain required.

Original spec and full source/execution maps are not edited or filtered. A deep-copied History input alone receives the disjoint three-source audit union, and the resolved historical map must equal the old map exactly.

The full old catalog is retained. The original completed_outputs receives the original spec. Rebind retains the last remover row's exact tool/owners/units/source delta and adds separately named post-exit audit provenance; it never attributes recovery sources to the old remover.

The complete old control namespace, directory/file identities and file hashes plus complete failed-finalizer transcript remain checked. Any missing/extra/replaced/changed node, old journal, old publication or their publishing temporary names rejects the narrow recovery branch.
The original lock, writer exclusion, resource floors/reservations and 7200-second work deadline remain. The new 128 MiB output reservation is additive and independently bounded.

Original History.physical_pair and Authority remain unchanged and share the reviewed external history_guard. Full two-pass process/service/cgroup checks are retained, including the historical r12 Authority.check metadata path.

Original verification authenticates every selected row before two complete metadata/allocation passes over all 2352 original/keeper pairs. Synthetic entry confirms 2352 times 3 times 2 identity observations, zero raw payload reads and zero reclaimed bytes.

The entire holder inspect AST matches the frozen original. Scope behavior is the frozen original with only exact helper target changed; nonce/ancestry/descriptor proof, actual foreground wait and complete helper drainage remain required before release.

Receipt then catalog then idle publication order is retained, each with full guards. Post-idle checks do not require the former running tip. Cleanup follows the original helper drain and retained-lock release rules; unresolved scope never releases.

V2 adds eleven bounded observational stage entry/exit events and cumulative full-guard time/count. Full guard and cadence function ASTs equal v1. Broken observational stdout does not bypass predicates or drain.
limits: This review did not inspect current lifecycle JSON, actual failed-state/control files, actual History resolution/physical evidence, proc, services, the lock, model/compiler state or raw payloads. It did not publish to GitHub or Feishu.

The parent's reported original 4693 executed-source binding was not independently recounted here. Source preservation was reviewed for the complete bound map without replacement or truncation; actual binding/hash acceptance remains the parent's responsibility.

Full checks are due at the first callback at least 0.5 seconds after the start of the prior full check. If a full check itself lasts at least 0.5 seconds, the next callback immediately performs another full check. This can retain substantial repeated work; source-only tests prove neither real acceleration nor completion within 7200 seconds.

The cadence changes global-predicate observation timing and is not a hard 0.5-second wall-clock bound through blocking work. A transient restored mutation can be missed between observations; the original writer exclusion and retained lock remain required.
The 7200-second work deadline is not permission to release an unresolved helper scope. Inherited drainage can retain ownership beyond the work deadline.

Successful synthetic tests are source evidence only. Fresh real observation/request/review, actual recovery tool terminal, complete output chain, old-snapshot preservation, real physical drainage and independent acceptance are still required.
